name: course-card
title: Course card
description: A course in a catalogue: cover, level, instructor, length, rating and price with its discount in words, or progress and Continue once enrolled.
docs: title, cover ({ src, alt }), instructor ({ name, image? }), level ('beginner', 'intermediate' or 'advanced': a word with a three-bar glyph), duration (minutes, written '6h 30m'), lessons, rating, ratingCount, price (minor units; 0 says 'Free'), compareAtPrice (struck through, with '38% off' in words), badge and href. The whole card is one link, through the title, so there is a single tab stop and nothing nested in a link. progress (0 to 100) turns it into an enrolled course: a progress bar and 'Continue' replace the price, and at 100 it says 'Completed' and 'Review'. The stars are one image named 'Rated 4.8 out of 5 by 1,284 learners'. locale writes the numbers and prices, headingAs sets the heading level (h3 by default) and labels holds the fixed words. It keeps no state and renders on the server.
